rationale: The only implementation delta is that the fixed version resets tu->qhead, tu->qtail, and tu->qused before freeing and reallocating the queues. The Logic section describes timer closure, copying selection data, opening a timer, allocating queues, cleanup on allocation failure, and callback/fast-flag setup; all of these occur in both versions. It does not mention queue-index state initialization or any equivalent behavior specific to the fixed implementation.
